name: Calibre-Web
description: Browse and read your Calibre ebook library.
notes: Default login admin / admin123 — change it right away.
compose:
services:
  calibre-web:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/calibre-web:latest
    container_name: calibre-web
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8083"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - /srv/books:/books
